_meta.doc: Per chapter: every non-temporary VAR_/FLAG_ its scripts set or read (incl. object hide flags, coord-trigger vars, hidden-item flags of owned maps). "home_*" = the first chapter (story order) that writes the id (each id has exactly one home). flags_item_balls_allocated = FLAG_ITEM_* (converter/gen_items.py, Black 2 flags 1100+n). Black 2 ids: data/story_ids.json ("b2_ids" below is a copy for convenience).
_meta.temporaries_excluded: FLAG_TEMP_*, VAR_TEMP_*, VAR_0x80xx, VAR_RESULT, VAR_FACING, VAR_LAST_TALKED, VAR_ITEM_ID, VAR_OBJ_GFX_ID_*, FLAG_VICTORY_ROAD_ROCK
